name: app-development-harness
description: Decision-led app delivery harness with dynamic stack optimization and release evidence

interface.shortDescription: Build apps through explicit product gates and verifiable delivery stages.
interface.longDescription: App Development Harness turns an app request into a resumable, evidence-backed delivery run. It records every decision, recommends technology from product constraints, and exposes blocking choices through a secure local dashboard.
defaultPrompt: Initialize App Harness for this project.
Resume the current App Harness run.
Open the App Harness decision dashboard.
